summary: This memo describes how to use Adobe's Secure Real-Time Media Flow Protocol (RTMFP) to carry video, audio, and data messages for Adobe Flash communications. It covers cryptographic methods, data formats, and flow control. It is informational and documents a vendor protocol rather than an IETF standard.

eli5.summary: Adobe Flash needed a way to send live video and chat between computers. This document explains the special delivery system Adobe made for that, written down so others can understand it.

questions: how does adobe flash send media
